summary: The General Manager, Transportation Services was authorized by City Council in December, 2016 to temporarily rescind turn prohibitions within Metrolinx Eglinton Crosstown LRT corridor, and specifically in the Forest Hill neighbourhoods. These relaxations were intended to facilitate access for residents and to balance the impact of Eglinton Crosstown LRT Forest Hill Station construction at the Eglinton Avenue West and Bathurst Street intersection. Most relaxations were planned to terminate at the end of March, 2018 when turns in all directions at the Bathurst St and Eglinton Avenue West intersection would be permitted. Crosslinx has confirmed all turns at the Bathurst Street and Eglinton Avenue West intersection will remain restricted until May 2019. Staff of the City, Metrolinx and Crosslinx Transit Solutions have had significant experience in 2017 monitoring the impact of construction on traffic in the area, and the responses of residents. They have advised it is now prudent to extend the turn prohibitions at specific locations until May 2019.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council temporarily rescind turn restrictions at the following locations from March 31, 2018 to and including May 31, 2019, in order to facilitate traffic movement in the vicinity of the intersection of Bathurst Street and Eglinton Avenue West during construction of the Forest Hill Station of the Metrolinx Eglinton Crosstown LRT: a. rescind the existing westbound right-turn prohibition in effect from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays (bicycles excepted), on Ava Road at Bathurst Street; b. rescind the existing southbound left-turn prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on Bathurst Street at Ava Road; c. rescind the existing westbound right-turn prohibition in effect from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays (bicycles excepted), on Rosemary Lane at Bathurst Street; d. rescind the existing southbound left-turn prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on Bathurst Street at Rosemary Lane; e. rescind the existing eastbound right-turn prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays (bicycles excepted), on Eglinton Avenue West at Chiltern Hill Road; f. rescind the existing…
